name: Organic Hybrid — one stem (the accepted body plan @2)
about: BLOOM-035B-5: Organic Hybrid's body plan in the per-plan layout. Its geometry IS the accepted body-plan@2 file art/plant/body-plan.json (one procedural stem per Cold layout, 117 sockets; byte-pinned by tools/organic-hybrid-art-intake-check.js S4) and its contract IS art/plant/contract.json (the locked 34-component Organic Hybrid registry + the shared materials / treatments / pixel rules). Both are REFERENCED, not copied, so the locked delivery and its PMO-pinned files stay byte-identical; skeleton `stem@2` is drawn by the accepted BLOOM-032B compositor path. Packs without a bodyPlan declaration are this plan only if listed in lockedPacks (the PMO-locked Organic Hybrid delivery, whose atlas.json the intake tool owns).
